    "allow_return_to_manager": false,
    "optimize": "Maximize the amg2023 figure of merit. You MUST maximize memory per CPU core. More cores are better.\nYou MUST run amg across UP TO 4 nodes. You MUST start with 1, then 2 nodes. You MUST set environment variables for MPI to use EFA with libfabric.\nThe trick to optimizing this is THREADING. You MUST force OpenMP and any math libraries to use only one thread per MPI rank. On example is setting OMP_NUM_THREADS to \"1\". You might also consider setting OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism to \"cma\" as a conservative builder will set to none.\nYOU MUST SLOWLY increase the problem size, one dimension at a time, by an increment no more than double the current to increase the FOM. A timeout may not require a smaller problem size but rather a different instance.\nA previous run example that has worked well:\n  amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 8 4 1 on m7g.16xlarge with FOM 8.039496e+08\nThe size of the MiniCluster MUST be no larger then 4. Tasks MUST be at least 4 per node.\nTo reduce noise in logging, you can set logging.quiet to true.\n",
    "resources": "The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. You must add the nodeSelector to use:  \n  m7g.16xlarge, 64 CPU, 256 GiB Memory, ARM (Graviton3)\nYou are still limited to up to 4 nodes.\n",
    "testing": "You MUST run AMG -problem 2. For testing choose a small problem size no greater than 4 in any dimension.    \n",
    "details": "You MUST run on up to 4 nodes and you MUST use only 1 node to first test. \nYou MUST set resource requests and limits to use vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1\nTasks MUST be at least 4.\nYou MUST NOT oversubscribe.\nSince this is an ARM instance you MUST change the flux.container.image to be\nghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9. Otherwise, do not change or set it.\nIf you are using an ARM instance you MUST also set flux.arch: \"arm\".\n"

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version corrects the previous error by setting 'launcher: true'
# and adds a nodeSelector to target the appropriate AWS instance type.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # CRITICAL FIX: Set to true. This ensures 'flux submit' runs inside
      # this container, which contains the 'amg2023' executable.
      launcher: true
      # Command to execute. Flux will automatically wrap this with its runner.
      # Runs AMG with problem type 2 and a small 4x4x4 problem size for testing.
      command: "amg2023 -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version corrects the previous error by adding environment variables
# required for AWS EFA networking and thread management.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # Command to execute. Flux will automatically wrap this with its runner.
      # Runs AMG with problem type 2 and a small 4x4x4 problem size for testing.
      command: "amg2023 -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # CRITICAL FIX: Add environment variables for EFA and threading.
      # These are required for the MPI application to initialize correctly.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version corrects the executable name in the command, which was the
# root cause of the previous failure.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # CRITICAL FIX: Corrected executable name from 'amg2023' to 'amg'.
      # Runs AMG with problem type 2 and a small 4x4x4 problem size for testing.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version addresses a command execution failure by explicitly
# invoking a shell to parse the command string, a robust pattern
# for ensuring commands with arguments are handled correctly.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # CRITICAL FIX: The command is wrapped in a shell invocation (/bin/sh -c)
      # to resolve potential execution errors where the system might misinterpret
      # a command with arguments as a single, non-existent file.
      command: "/bin/sh -c 'amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4'"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version corrects the previous shell syntax error by removing the
# unnecessary `/bin/sh -c` wrapper from the command string.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # CRITICAL FIX: The command is a simple string. The redundant shell
      # wrapper that caused a syntax error has been removed.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version corrects the MPI initialization error by explicitly directing
# Open MPI to use the Flux Process Launch Module (PLM).
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # The command to execute. Flux handles the MPI launching.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for networking, threading, and MPI integration.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
        # CRITICAL FIX: Instructs Open MPI to use the Flux scheduler for
        # launching processes, resolving the ssh/rsh error.
        OMPI_MCA_plm: "flux"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version resolves an MPI component error by removing the conflicting
# 'OMPI_MCA_plm: flux' environment variable. The Flux Operator's default
# launch mechanism is sufficient and does not require this override.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # The command to execute. Flux handles the MPI launching.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for networking and threading.
      # CRITICAL FIX: The OMPI_MCA_plm variable has been removed as it was
      # incompatible with the Open MPI build in the container.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for running AMG2023 on an AWS ARM64 CPU instance.
# This version addresses an MPI initialization failure by explicitly using
# 'flux run' to launch the application, ensuring the Flux resource manager
# handles process spawning instead of Open MPI's default ssh/rsh mechanism.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run across the MiniCluster. Must be at least 4.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure the job does not clean up pods upon completion for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Set strict logging for better error visibility.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for ARM instances as required.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the specific ARM64 image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # This must be true to ensure the command runs in the application container.
      launcher: true
      # CRITICAL FIX: The command now explicitly uses 'flux run' to ensure
      # Open MPI uses the Flux scheduler for process management, resolving
      # the ssh/rsh initialization error. The task count '-n 4' matches spec.tasks.
      command: "flux run -n 4 amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA networking devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# MiniCluster manifest for a small-scale test of AMG on an AWS ARM instance.
# This configuration adheres to strict operational constraints, prioritizing
# the Flux Operator's default job submission logic over in-container commands.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run. Set to the minimum requirement for testing.
  tasks: 4

  # Per instructions, cleanup MUST be false to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Per instructions, logging MUST be set to strict for detailed debugging.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Per ARM instance instructions, arch MUST be set to "arm".
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Per ARM instance instructions, the specific ARM image MUST be used.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule pods only on nodes with this specific AWS instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # Per instructions, launcher MUST be false. The Flux Operator handles submission.
      launcher: false
      # Command to execute. Per instructions, this MUST NOT include 'flux run'.
      # Using a small problem size (<= 4) for testing as required.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Per instructions, resource requests/limits for the EFA device MUST be set.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

# MiniCluster manifest for a small-scale test of AMG on an AWS ARM instance.
# This version corrects a typo in the nodeSelector key, which was preventing
# pods from being scheduled and causing a timeout.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: amg2023-mc-aws-cpu
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for initial testing.
  size: 1
  # The maximum number of pods for scaling, as requested.
  maxSize: 4
  # Total MPI tasks to run. Set to the minimum requirement for testing.
  tasks: 4

  # Per instructions, cleanup MUST be false to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Per instructions, logging MUST be set to strict for detailed debugging.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux Operator specific settings for the Flux Framework itself.
  flux:
    # Per ARM instance instructions, arch MUST be set to "arm".
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Per ARM instance instructions, the specific ARM image MUST be used.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # CRITICAL FIX: Corrected a typo from 'node.kubernetes.ioio/instance-type'
      # to 'node.kubernetes.io/instance-type' to enable successful pod scheduling.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # Per instructions, launcher MUST be false. The Flux Operator handles submission.
      launcher: false
      # Command to execute. Using a small problem size (<= 4) for testing as required.
      command: "amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4"
      # Environment variables for EFA networking and OpenMP threading.
      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: "efa"
        FI_EFA_USE_DEVICE_RDMA: "1"
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: "cma"
      # Per instructions, resource requests/limits for the EFA device MUST be set.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
